title: Archana, Parmeet's son Aaryamann recalls being bullied in UK during football training
description: Originally aiming for a career in football, Aaryamann Sethi faced a tough turn of events when injuries struck during his training in England. Battling feelings of isolation and bullying in boarding school, he suffered two serious leg fractures that ended his aspirations. With encouragement from his family, he pivoted to creative outlets, now expressing his story through his YouTube channel, Aary Vlogs, alongside pursuits in music and acting.

title: When Raj spoke about falling in love with Smita despite being married to Nadira

He later fell in love with actress Smita Patil, leading to considerable controversy around their relationship. After getting married in 1983, they welcomed their son Prateik, but their happiness was short-lived. Smita passed away shortly after childbirth, leaving a profound impact on Raj and the film industry.

title: Imran Khan seeks urgent stay on notice to leave India, moves to Bombay High Court
description: In a poignant legal move, actor Imran Khan has filed a petition with the Bombay High Court against an issued removal notice, arguing it was served without a fair hearing, violating his rights. As an Overseas Citizen of India who has lived in India since age two, Khan contends he faced wrongful detention during a protest in Mumbai, seeking to annul the notice due to its vague claims.

title: Saif proposed to Kareena in Paris, Greece: 'That's when I said yes'
description: Marking 14 years of partnership, Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan took a moment to reflect on their emotional journey together. Kareena divulged that Saif popped the question thrice in iconic locations like Mumbai, Greece, and Paris before she finally accepted. They married in 2012. On this special occasion, Kareena shared cherished memories via social media.

title: Ektaa recalls discovering hate groups targeting her and Aishwarya, says there's Hinduphobia among people

She reflected on being mocked for wearing traditional religious symbols and the judgment related to her faith. Ekta also expressed concern about the perceived Hinduphobia surrounding Indian folklore and mythology in contemporary media. She emphasized the importance of accepting and discussing these cultural narratives.
